gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
I haven't enjoyed myself so much for years.
gaps.sentence: It's ___ I've enjoyed myself so much.
gaps.explanation: It's (been) years since + past simple = I haven't done it for years.

gaps.lead: It was a mistake not to write the telephone number down.
gaps.sentence: I should ___ writing down the telephone number.
gaps.hint: make a point of doing = be sure to do
gaps.explanation: Regret about an omitted action: 'should have made a point of writing it down'.

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: The journey was so tiring that we slept all day.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that we slept all day.
gaps.explanation: so tiring (a journey) → such a tiring journey.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.
